marketing_description: The JET JWBS Series Bandsaw, part number JT9-714400K, features a cutting capacity of 13-1/2 in and a blade length of 116 in. It operates at a voltage rating of 115/230 V and a frequency rating of 60 Hz, with a HP rating of 1-3/4 hp. The bandsaw measures 27-1/2 in in overall width and 75-3/8 in in overall depth.
